combination_rule: overall PASS iff C1 (the DEDICATED proximity signal finds a reachable+discriminating threshold under limb_damage_enabled=True). C2 (does the damage-sourced z_harm_a discriminate under the same scenario) is a REPORTED control, NOT load-bearing: it is expected to FAIL (reproducing V3-EXQ-917's chance-level C1) and its failure confirms the dedicated signal was necessary; a surprising C2 PASS is a context note, not a run failure.
evidence_direction_note: 2026-08-16 governance (confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-930_2026-08-16): the manifest's self-stamped evidence_direction 'supports' is OVERRIDDEN to non_contributory. V3-EXQ-930 is a SUBSTRATE-READINESS validation of SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING at the signal layer; the MECH-303 gate itself was never enabled (use_contextual_safety_terrain default False), the agent was untrained, and no vigilance/avoidance readout was taken -- the claim could not express itself. The signal-layer result stands on its own terms (monotone across hazard density, best AUC 1.0 at tau=0.08); it is the MECH-303 attribution that does not follow.

preconditions.control: every arm in the battery (all 5 density levels)
preconditions.description: fraction of battery ticks where BOTH z_harm_a.norm() and safety_proximity_harm return a finite value -- the gate signals' own reachability, not their discrimination
preconditions.name: both_signals_apparatus_reachable

preconditions.control: positive control = hazard density genuinely varies 0->8 across the battery
preconditions.description: std across the 5 per-density means of the DEDICATED signal -- the SAME cross-density range statistic the load-bearing AUC criterion routes on (not a magnitude proxy); a flat signal means the dedicated channel is inert/misconfigured
preconditions.name: dedicated_signal_varies_with_density

notes: Validation of SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (landed 2026-08-14, ree-v3 b257e7ad14). Measures BOTH candidate MECH-303 gate signals per tick from the SAME live path under the production scenario (limb_damage_enabled=True) that V3-EXQ-917 showed defeats z_harm_a: the DEDICATED proximity signal obs_dict['safety_proximity_harm'] (C1, load-bearing) vs the damage-sourced z_harm_a.norm() (C2, control). Acceptance: the dedicated signal clears a reachable+discriminating threshold (AUC>=0.75 pre-registered bar; ~0.84 acceptance target from the failure record) that the damage-sourced signal cannot -- validating that the decoupling gives MECH-303's gate a working signal even when SD-022 body-damage sourcing is active. GOV-REUSE-1: the dedicated signal did not exist before b257e7ad14, so no prior manifest on any substrate_hash carries this readout -- not recoverable, ran fresh. C1/C2 combination is NOT a plain AND (see combination_rule): C1 alone gates the PASS.
